attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates final tax balance - total tax minus credits and payments to determine refund or amount owed per Form 1040 Lines 33-37.

initial_action.action_dsl: set result.total_tax = tax_before_credits - nonrefundable_credits + ptc_repayment, add refundable credits to payments
initial_action.action_postfix: "FINAL CALCULATION (Form 1040 Lines 33-37)" job.audit_trail swap addto result.total_tax_before_credits result.amt_owed f+ /result.tax_before_nonrefundable_credits xdef result.total_credits result.total_ctc f- /result.other_nonrefundable_credits xdef result.tax_before_nonrefundable_credits result.other_nonrefundable_credits f- 0.0 fmax /result.tax_for_ctc xdef result.total_ctc result.tax_for_ctc fmin /result.ctc_used xdef result.total_ctc result.ctc_used f- /result.total_actc xdef result.ctc_used /result.total_ctc xdef result.ctc_used result.other_nonrefundable_credits f+ /result.total_nonrefundable_credits xdef result.tax_before_nonrefundable_credits result.total_nonrefundable_credits f- result.ptc_repayment f+ /result.total_tax xdef result.eitc result.total_payments f+ /result.total_payments xdef result.total_actc result.total_payments f+ /result.total_payments xdef result.total_aotc_refundable result.total_payments f+ /result.total_payments xdef " Line 19 - CTC (non-refundable): $" result.ctc_used cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Line 27 - EITC: $" result.eitc cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Line 28 - ACTC (refundable): $" result.total_actc cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Line 29 - AOTC (refundable portion): $" result.total_aotc_refundable cvs strconcat " per IRC 25A(i)(5)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
